name: Sikafloor®-94
tagline: Low viscosity, solvent free epoxy Primer and general purpose Binder resin
summary: Sikafloor®-94 is a two component, low viscosity, 100% Solid Epoxy Primer and Binder resin system
metaDescription: Sikafloor®-94 is a two component, low viscosity, 100% Solid Epoxy Primer and Binder resin system
attributes: Can be accelerated with Sikafloor Booster
usage: Primer for concrete surfaces with Sikafloor resin systems.
Binder resin for Epoxy mortar Sub-fill mortar screeds.
Flow and scratch coat layering prior to Sikafloor systems.
advantages: Can be accelerated with Sikafloor Booster
packaging: Available in proportioned 30 kg, 60 litres and Bulk 200 kg Parts A+B

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Potable Water certified to AS 4020 - 2014
VOC compliance to Aust. Green Building Codes V1.1-13.1.1 and V1.1-12.1.1B

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored in original sealed containers within the temperature range of +5 to +35 degress C, this product will keep for 3 years from date of manufactre.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Stored in a dry place and out of direct sunlight within temperatures as mentioned above.

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Part A Part B = 2 :1 (by Mass and Volume)

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: Application range recommended +5 to +30 Degrees C

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
10 Degrees C - 30 mins.
20 Degrees C - 20 mins.

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
10 degrees C 15 hours
20 degrees C 8 hours
Note: Waiting times are approximately halved with the addition of Sikafloor Booster

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Primer
CSP 2-3 profile 5-6m2 L approx.
CSP 4-5 profile 2-3m2 L approx.
Mortar
Range of 1:5 to 1:8 mixed litre of Sikafloor®-94 to kg blended silica sands

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Part A and B to be mixed the correct ratio for a minimum of 2 minutes

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Primer
Roll product evenly on and into the surface.
If the product is completely absorbed then an additional coat should be applied within 24 hours.
Mortar
When used as a binder in Profiling screeds or Coving mixes, the substrate should also be primed with Sikafloor®-94
